description: This file defines the 'StuckGrain' class implementing grain behavior for testing activation and deactivation scenarios in Orleans, along with a cleanup grain. It includes methods for controlling grain activation state, blocking deactivation, and tracking activation calls.

classes.name: StuckGrain
classes.description: A grain class used for testing activation, deactivation, and blocking behavior in Orleans.

classes.name: StuckCleanupGrain
classes.description: A grain class providing cleanup and release functionalities for 'StuckGrain'.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases a grain by its Guid key, signaling deactivation.

methods.name: WaitForDeactivationStart
methods.description: Waits asynchronously until deactivation has started for a given grain ID.

methods.name: SetDeactivationStarted
methods.description: Marks deactivation as started for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: BlockCallingTestUntilDeactivation
methods.description: Blocks the calling thread until deactivation is triggered for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: IsActivated
methods.description: Checks if a grain with the specified Guid is currently activated.

methods.name: RunForever
methods.description: Returns a task that completes only when deactivation is triggered, used to simulate a long-running grain.

methods.name: NonBlockingCall
methods.description: Increments a call counter for the grain without blocking.

methods.name: GetNonBlockingCallCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the number of non-blocking calls made to the grain.

methods.name: DidActivationTryToStart
methods.description: Checks if activation was attempted for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: BlockingDeactivation
methods.description: Sets the grain to block deactivation until explicitly released.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain activation, including optional delay based on context.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles grain deactivation, including logging and cleanup.
